specFidelityNotes: Slices A+B match ADR-051 / #593 intent. Catalog builder (scripts/tiktok_corpora_catalog/) parses YAML front matter into ADR minimum fields, omits bodies, skips _raw paths, supports JULI_TIKTOK_CORPORA_ROOT; CLI writes three *-catalog.json under docs/integrations/tiktok_corpora/. Committed catalogs (882 business, 839 academy, 365 partner entries) contain metadata only — partner catalog has zero _raw paths. Playbook README covers residency, env override, crawler retarget, retrieval protocol, authority split, phase gate, fail-soft missing bodies. Focus SKILL.md + routing-rules.md route Architect/Meta to playbook+catalogs with explicit Executor/Review DO NOT Load. Meta wiring: slice-routing.yml CORPORA-1 + agent-runtime.config.yml epic 593 align with handoff. 9/9 fixture unit tests pass. HITL residency bootstrap (move/symlink to Juli-AI-local) and manual Grep→Read smoke are documented but not provable in diff — expected per PRD/handoff; validate phase owns smoke evidence.
